scope: Prevent an auto-hidden Dock from being painted on its previous monitor during a pointer handoff.

checks.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_dock_always_visible.py tests/test_dock_follows_screen_dwell.py (Tahoe shared implementation)

coverage_limits: Script regression checks simulate two outputs. The updated effect was loaded on a two-monitor KDE Wayland desktop. Physical pointer motion was not independently observed.
